gloss: real estate agent; real estate agency

definitions.gloss: real estate agent; real estate agency
definitions.explanation: A person or business that deals with the buying, selling, and renting of properties. Common casual term for real estate professionals in Japan.

examples.japanese: {不動産屋|ふどうさんや}で{部屋|へや}を{探|さが}した。
examples.english: I looked for an apartment at a real estate agency.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}に{不動産屋|ふどうさんや}がたくさんある。
examples.english: There are many real estate agencies in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {不動産屋|ふどうさんや}に{仲介|ちゅうかい}{手数料|てすうりょう}を{払|はら}った。
examples.english: I paid a brokerage fee to the real estate agent.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{不動産|ふどうさん} (real estate) + {屋|や} (shop/business suffix)

FORMAL ALTERNATIVES:
・{不動産|ふどうさん}{会社|かいしゃ} (real estate company)
・{不動産|ふどうさん}{業者|ぎょうしゃ} (real estate dealer)
・{宅地|たくち}{建物|たてもの}{取引|とりひき}{業者|ぎょうしゃ} (licensed real estate transaction business - official term)

LICENSING:
Real estate agents in Japan need:
・{宅地|たくち}{建物|たてもの}{取引士|とりひきし} (real estate transaction specialist license)
・{宅建|たっけん} (abbreviation for the above license/exam)

COMMON SERVICES:
・{賃貸|ちんたい}{物件|ぶっけん} (rental properties)
・{売買|ばいばい}{物件|ぶっけん} (properties for sale)
・{部屋|へや}{探|さが}し (apartment hunting)

FEES:
・{仲介|ちゅうかい}{手数料|てすうりょう} (brokerage fee) - typically 1 month's rent for rentals
・{礼金|れいきん}/{敷金|しききん} (key money/security deposit) - arranged through agent

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{不動産屋|ふどうさんや}に{行|い}く (to go to a real estate agency)
・{不動産屋|ふどうさんや}で{物件|ぶっけん}を{探|さが}す (to look for properties at an agency)
・{不動産屋|ふどうさんや}を{通|とお}す (to go through a real estate agent)
